svg.title: When the Policy Doesn't Say
svg.desc: A decision path for policy questions: if the policy covers the tool, data and use, follow it in the approved workspace; if a setting or connector blocks legitimate work, request it through the proper route; otherwise ask the policy owner before acting, never using a personal or colleague's account or asking Claude to interpret the policy.
svg.text: Follow it, in the approved workspace
Request it through the proper route
Ask the policy owner before acting
